result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d erase the fear that holds people back—fear of failure, judgment, or not being loved. Because when fear loses its grip, creativity flourishes. Honesty becomes easier. People start to protect what matters instead of clinging to what doesn’t. And maybe, just maybe, we’d finally prioritize love over power and trust over control.

What about you? What single change do you think the world needs most right now?
